contextReview.basis: Direct review: cloudy night harbour promenade with warm stucco walls, wall lamps and moored boats; no rain depicted (dry-looking paving); humidity not inferred.

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: The black shorts and dark charcoal full-length leggings are separate products. Hidden backs and soles are inferred. Brand, fibre composition and retail identity are unknown.

deck.ko: 세이지와 크림, 짙은 하의 위의 부드러운 두 겹.
deck.en: Sage and cream soften two dark lower layers.
deck.de: Salbei und Creme mildern zwei dunkle Unterlagen.

intro.ko: 넓은 계단에 발을 올리고 양말 가장자리를 바로잡습니다.
intro.en: With one foot on the broad step, he straightens the sock edge.
intro.de: Mit einem Fuß auf der breiten Stufe richtet er den Sockenrand.

body.ko: 세이지 셸은 크림 목선과 커프를 조금 드러냅니다. 검정 쇼츠와 차콜 레깅스 아래 흰 리브 양말이 짧게 보이고 회색 신발의 흰 중창과 연결됩니다. 고개를 숙인 시선과 손의 작은 동작이 착장의 층을 자연스럽게 보여줍니다.
body.en: The sage shell leaves a little cream at the neck and cuffs. Short white ribbed socks show beneath black shorts and charcoal leggings, connecting with the white midsoles of gray shoes. The lowered gaze and small hand movement reveal the layers naturally.
body.de: Die Salbeijacke lässt etwas Creme an Hals und Bündchen frei. Kurze weiße Rippensocken zeigen sich unter schwarzen Shorts und anthrazitfarbenen Tights und verbinden sich mit den weißen Zwischensohlen. Gesenkter Blick und kleine Handbewegung machen die Lagen natürlich lesbar.

pull.en: A small adjustment sets the rhythm.
pull.de: Eine kleine Korrektur gibt den Rhythmus.

copy.pullQuoteEn: A small adjustment sets the rhythm.

tip.ko: 흰 양말의 보이는 높이를 양쪽에서 맞춰보세요.
tip.en: Match the visible height of both white socks.
tip.de: Die sichtbare Höhe beider weißen Socken angleichen.
